Identiv, Inc. Sells IoT Unit; Renamed INVE Technologies

Kirsten Newquist Resigns From INVE Technologies
: Identiv (INVE) CEO Kirsten Newquist will resign effective Sept 21, 2026; she stays employed through Sept and leaves the INVE Technologies board effective Sept 30, 2026.
